title: Standard Employee Paystub
description: The standard paystub for a regular, ongoing employee. This template calculates standard withholdings (federal/state tax, FICA) and is suitable for most traditional employment relationships with a consistent schedule.

title: Independent Contractor Invoice & Earnings Statement
description: Designed for 1099 contractors, this template functions as both an invoice for services rendered and an earnings summary. It highlights gross pay without traditional employee tax withholdings, emphasizing it is not a W-2 wage statement.

title: Temporary Assignment Paystub
description: This paystub is tailored for employees hired through a staffing agency or for a specific, short-term assignment. It may include details about the hiring agency, client company, and the assignment period.

title: On-Call / Casual Labor Paystub
description: For employees with irregular, on-call hours. This template is structured to clearly list callback periods, standby premiums, and varying hourly rates that are common in on-call or casual work arrangements.

title: Salaried (Exempt) Employee Paystub
description: For employees exempt from overtime pay. This template shows a consistent salary amount per pay period, regardless of hours worked, and does not include an overtime calculation field.

title: Fixed-Term Contract Paystub
description: Used for employees on a specific contract with a defined end date (e.g., a 12-month project). This stub often references the contract details and may track remaining contract value or milestone-based payments.

title: Hourly (Non-Exempt) Employee Paystub
description: Designed for employees eligible for overtime. This template features detailed sections for regular hours, overtime hours (at 1.5x or 2x the rate), double-time, and other premium pays, ensuring FLSA compliance.

title: Full-Time Employment Paystub
description: Reflects the earnings and deductions for an employee working full-time hours (typically 35+ per week). This template often includes a comprehensive breakdown of full-time benefits like health insurance, retirement contributions, and paid time off (PTO) accruals.

title: Part-Time Employment Paystub
description: For employees working less than full-time hours. This paystub clearly shows pro-rated benefits (if any) and is structured for variable hours that are still expected to be consistent each period.

title: Volunteer Stipend & Reimbursement Summary
description: This is not a traditional paystub but a summary of any stipends, allowances, or expense reimbursements provided to a volunteer. It explicitly states that these are not wages for services and are not subject to standard payroll taxes (unless required by law).

title: Draw Against Commission Paystub
description: For sales employees who receive a regular draw that is later reconciled against earned commission. This stub clearly shows the draw amount, commission earned, and the remaining draw balance.

title: Commission-Only Earnings Statement
description: A paystub for employees compensated solely on commission. It itemizes sales, commission rates, and gross earnings without any base salary or hourly wage.

title: Base Salary + Bonus Paystub
description: Details a regular salary plus a discrete bonus payment. It separates the bonus amount and may show a different withholding calculation for supplemental income.

title: Profit-Sharing Distribution Statement
description: Outlines an employee share of company profits distributed as part of a compensation package. This is often a separate payment from regular wages.

title: Royalty Earnings Statement
description: For authors, artists, or inventors receiving royalty payments. It details the royalty period, units sold/licensed, rate, and gross royalty income.

title: Retainer Fee Paystub
description: For consultants or professionals on a monthly retainer. This stub shows the fixed retainer fee and may track hours used against the retainer balance.

title: Milestone Bonus Paystub
description: Issued for achieving specific project or performance milestones. The description field links the bonus to a particular goal.

title: Stock Option Exercise Statement
description: Details the transaction and associated taxes when an employee exercises their company stock options.

title: RSU (Restricted Stock Unit) Vesting Statement
description: Shows the value of vested RSUs and the taxes withheld upon vesting, which is considered taxable income.

title: Hospitality & Tips Paystub
description: For restaurant and hotel staff. This template has detailed sections for reporting cash tips, credit card tips, tip pooling, and tip credit claimed by the employer.

title: Hospitality - Tip Credit Reconciliation Stub
description: A specific stub for jurisdictions where employers claim a tip credit, showing the direct wage, tip credit amount, and ensuring the total meets minimum wage.

title: Freelance Creative Project Paystub
description: Tailored for freelance designers, writers, etc. It includes project names, purchase order numbers, and can itemize deliverables.

title: Construction Payroll - Certified Paystub
description: Used for public works projects, this certified report includes detailed labor classifications, prevailing wages, and fringe benefit contributions as required by law.

title: Day Rate Paystub (e.g., Film, Oil & Gas)
description: For industries that pay a fixed rate per day worked. It lists the day rate, number of days, and any special allowances (e.g., hazard pay).

title: Per Diem Employee Paystub
description: For employees receiving a daily allowance for meals and incidentals while traveling. This clearly separates non-taxable per diem from taxable wages.

title: Travel Nurse / Allied Health Paystub
description: For traveling healthcare professionals. Includes hourly wages, overtime, and detailed breakdowns of travel reimbursements, housing stipends, and bonuses.

title: Non-Profit Grant-Funded Position Paystub
description: For employees whose salary is funded by a specific grant. The stub may include the grant name and number for accounting purposes.

title: Seasonal Employment Paystub
description: Ideal for workers employed during specific seasons or peaks (e.g., holiday, harvest). This paystub can note the seasonal period and is configured for potentially intense, short-duration work schedules.
